entities.summary: Aleksandr Nikiforovich Aksyonov was a Soviet politician and diplomat from Belarus. Aksyonov served as the Prime Minister of the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic from 11 December 1978, until 7 July 1983. He later became the Soviet Ambassador to Poland from 1983 to 1986. He was a member of the Central Committee for the Communist Party of Byelorussia from 1956 to 1986.
